objective: Prove authenticated dynamic discovery, safe automatic and manual selection, structured multidomain orchestration, abstention, sparse execution, and catalog-management scalability without modifying the sealed core or sealed capability packages.

immutable_boundaries.router_profiles: campaign-authenticated metadata bound to exact cake_id and archive SHA-256

routing_modes.automatic_top1: select at most one eligible installed cake or abstain
routing_modes.automatic_topk: select up to two eligible installed cakes
routing_modes.multidomain: split an explicitly separable request into ordered independent subrequests, route and execute each subrequest, then return a structured result envelope
routing_modes.manual: execute only explicitly named eligible installed cakes
routing_modes.abstention: select no cake and return control to the unchanged core handler

router.architecture: deterministic catalog-profile scorer with phrase, token, and anchored-pattern evidence; no fixed domain output head
router.catalog_output_set: derived at refresh time from eligible installed package records and archive-bound profiles
router.profile_selection: fixed before final-suite generation and access
router.profile_source: public task vocabulary and package metadata; no held-out output or label feedback

top1.promoted_metric: micro accuracy recomputed from every raw decision

topk_and_multidomain.promoted_metric: micro recall over required package identities

negative_and_core.promoted_metric: false specialist activations divided by all negative decisions

functional_execution.source: the frozen Phase 4 Python and Phase 5 SQL/regex held-out functional rows

external_boundary.protocol: UTF-8 JSON request and response documents through a fresh subprocess

catalog_scaling.remaining_entries: management-only unavailable descriptors, explicitly excluded from capability and execution claims

timing.primary_route_metric: median router wall time divided by median routed LayerCake end-to-end wall time

systems: Phase 4 optimized CPU Qwen 2.5 0.5B Q4_K_M product baseline
mixed_workload_cpu_comparison.primary_metric: median paired UTF-8 output bytes per second ratio after adding measured warm routing latency to LayerCake
mixed_workload_cpu_comparison.quality_condition: LayerCake must retain the complete promoted functional success set; transformer quality is reported separately and never borrowed
mixed_workload_cpu_comparison.baseline_reuse: permitted only for immutable Phase 4 raw observations whose model digest, prompts, thread count, CPU-only setting, and output policy are verified
mixed_workload_cpu_comparison.new_sql_regex_transformer_credit: not claimed without new matched raw transformer runs
